# Affirmation trios for the year

Fixed assignment of three affirmations to each date. The first number is the affirmation written for that date. The other two are recycled.

Checked: every affirmation is used exactly three times, no trio repeats, the three in a trio come from different subjects, and each use of an affirmation is at least 45 days from its other uses.
